task.ques: Find out how much more package storage the Enterprise version has over Team in GitHub Pricing.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: GitHub Enterprise has 48 GB more Packages storage than Team: 50 GB versus 2 GB (50 − 2 = 48 GB).
Evidence: GitHub Pricing, https://github.com/pricing, checked October 28, 2026. The “GitHub Packages” comparison row shows Team at “2GB” and Enterprise at “50GB”; both say “Free for public repositories.” Screenshot: final.png.
